name: print-social-youth-fashion-revolution-poster-black-glossy-orange-blobs
title: 'The Youth Fashion Revolution' poster with glossy orange 3D blob letters on black and a pink flower badge
whatItIs: A pink-bordered black square poster with two glossy orange 3D blob shapes (one shaped like a plus sign) flanking bold cream text 'The Youth Fashion Revolution', a circular pink-and-orange flower badge above, and a cream 'Visit Our Website' button.
whatItMeans: Bold and youthful; glossy squishy 3D shapes give a fashion statement real physical presence and playfulness.
techniques: Use glossy 3D blob shapes as pure abstract decoration.
Frame a black poster in one bright contrasting border colour.
Place a circular badge above the headline as a stamp-like anchor.

vocabulary.definition: A glossy, softly rendered organic shape.
A circular emblem with petal-like radiating shapes.
